status: research hypotheses only; no live implementation authorization

rules.name: staged_entry
rules.hypothesis: Split a qualified spot entry into 2-3 tranches only while the original signal remains valid.
rules.test_design: Compare single-fill vs time/price-staged entries on identical historical signals after gas/slippage.

rules.name: tranche_exit
rules.hypothesis: For illiquid/high-impact assets, split exits into tranches instead of one market-sized exit.
rules.test_design: Simulate one-shot versus 3-tranche exits using liquidity-aware slippage and route quotes.

rules.name: yield_overlay
rules.hypothesis: After spot acquisition, eligible idle inventory may earn additional yield through staking/LP.
rules.test_design: Measure incremental net yield after gas, IL, smart-contract and lockup costs.

rules.name: stable_yield_rotation
rules.hypothesis: Rotate stablecoin reserves into vetted yield instruments only when net expected yield exceeds execution/risk hurdle.
rules.test_design: Backtest yield sleeve independently from trading alpha with depeg/withdrawal stress.

rules.name: treasury_strategy_separation
rules.hypothesis: Keep treasury, active strategy and experimental DeFi wallets separated with hard capital limits.
rules.test_design: Operational architecture review; no performance backtest required.

rules.name: cross_chain_opportunity_routing
rules.hypothesis: Move capital across chains only when expected post-bridge advantage exceeds all costs and security premium.
rules.test_design: Model bridge fee, latency, gas, failure and price movement; reject if benefit is marginal.

rules.name: hard_drawdown_guard_override
rules.hypothesis: Do not copy observed long-duration bag holding; retain Arz position/drawdown stops regardless of source wallet behavior.
rules.test_design: Stress-test strict risk caps against no-stop baseline.

rules.name: exclude_nonrepeatable_alpha
rules.hypothesis: Claims, airdrops, vesting and treasury transfers must be excluded from trader win-rate and strategy alpha.
rules.test_design: Accounting rule: tag non-market acquisition basis separately.

rules.name: exclude_leverage
rules.hypothesis: Do not reproduce Deficity borrowing/leveraged-farming behavior in Arz.

rules.name: route_quality
rules.hypothesis: For the same trade signal, router/venue selection should minimize total execution cost rather than copy the exact venue used by TradeCityPro.
rules.test_design: Quote multiple allowed DEX routes and compare net fill after gas/slippage/MEV.
